title: Excessively large side margins for non-floating space-filling panel
line: The first and last widgets on a panel now sit closer to the screen edges, as in Plasma 5, and text widgets keep their room.
explanation: The panel containment set its end margins to the theme's panel margin plus an extra smallSpacing (4 px), added in 2023 as a workaround for widgets whose content touched their own edges (plasma-desktop issue 116). With Breeze that gives 8 px at each end, so Kickoff and the last widget always stay away from the screen edges, unlike Plasma 5 which used the theme margin alone. The extra spacing is now gone for every panel (floating, non-floating, horizontal and vertical), and PanelView's edge-click padding matches it again. An audit of 30 widgets at both panel ends found only User Switcher and Timer still drawing text right up to their own edges; they now pad their labels with smallSpacing in horizontal panels, as Kickoff's label does.

commits.message:
containments/panel: drop the extra spacing at the panel ends

Panels added a small spacing at both ends on top of the theme margins,
a workaround for widgets whose content touched their own edges, so the
outer widgets never reached the screen edges. Use the margins alone.

BUG: 478240

applets: give the User Switcher and Timer labels room at their edges

The user name and the countdown were laid out right up to the widgets'
edges, so they touched the panel margin when placed at either end. Add
a small spacing around them in horizontal panels, as Kickoff does.

BUG: 478240

From c1a990bb32c1e3f653960da7e4747fcfcd3d12f1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 00:11:23 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets: give the User Switcher and Timer labels room at
 their edges

The user name and the countdown were laid out right up to the widgets'
edges, so they touched the panel margin when placed at either end. Add
a small spacing around them in horizontal panels, as Kickoff does.

BUG: 478240
---
 applets/timer/CompactRepresentation.qml | 2 ++
 applets/userswitcher/qml/main.qml       | 2 ++
 2 files changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/timer/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/timer/CompactRepresentation.qml
index bf61fe7b6..58553f91f 100644
--- a/applets/timer/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/timer/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -176,6 +176,8 @@ Item {
                 }
             }
             Layout.maximumHeight: textMetrics.height * 2
+            Layout.leftMargin: layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.HorizontalPanel && !iconItem.visible ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0
+            Layout.rightMargin: layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.HorizontalPanel ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0
             visible: compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.IconOnly ? 1 : 0
 
             spacing: parent.columnSpacing
diff --git a/applets/userswitcher/qml/main.qml b/applets/userswitcher/qml/main.qml
index 1513009d2..52987455e 100644
--- a/applets/userswitcher/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/userswitcher/qml/main.qml
@@ -75,6 +75,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
             anchors.centerIn: parent
             spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+            leftPadding: !root.isVertical && label.visible && !icon.visible ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0
+            rightPadding: !root.isVertical && label.visible ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0
 
             KirigamiComponents.Avatar {
                 id: icon
-- 
2.53.0

From b491152e95b18e01c20105344a640fe7060f6c63 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 00:11:23 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/panel: drop the extra spacing at the panel ends

Panels added a small spacing at both ends on top of the theme margins,
a workaround for widgets whose content touched their own edges, so the
outer widgets never reached the screen edges. Use the margins alone.

BUG: 478240
---
 containments/panel/main.qml             | 8 ++++----
 desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml | 8 ++++----
 2 files changed, 8 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)

diff --git a/containments/panel/main.qml b/containments/panel/main.qml
index 4ee220333e..f8aef51d94 100644
--- a/containments/panel/main.qml
+++ b/containments/panel/main.qml
@@ -383,10 +383,10 @@ ContainmentItem {
 //BEGIN UI elements
 
         anchors {
-            leftMargin: root.isHorizontal ? Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.left + currentLayout.rowSpacing) : 0
-            rightMargin: root.isHorizontal ? Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.right + currentLayout.rowSpacing) : 0
-            topMargin: root.isHorizontal ? 0 : Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.top + currentLayout.rowSpacing)
-            bottomMargin: root.isHorizontal ? 0 : Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.bottom + currentLayout.rowSpacing)
+            leftMargin: root.isHorizontal ? Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.left) : 0
+            rightMargin: root.isHorizontal ? Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.right) : 0
+            topMargin: root.isHorizontal ? 0 : Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.top)
+            bottomMargin: root.isHorizontal ? 0 : Math.min(dropArea.spacingAtMinSize, panelSvg.fixedMargins.bottom)
         }
 
         Item {
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
index aea1844c5b..fdf1fd56dd 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/Panel.qml
@@ -57,10 +57,10 @@ Item {
     readonly property int fixedRightFloatingPadding: floating && (floatingPrefix ? floatingPanelSvg.fixedMargins.right  : 8)
     readonly property int fixedTopFloatingPadding: floating && (floatingPrefix ? floatingPanelSvg.fixedMargins.top    : 8)
 
-    readonly property int topPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.top + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, spacingAtMinSize));
-    readonly property int bottomPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.bottom + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, spacingAtMinSize));
-    readonly property int leftPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.left + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, spacingAtMinSize));
-    readonly property int rightPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.right + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing, spacingAtMinSize));
+    readonly property int topPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.top, spacingAtMinSize));
+    readonly property int bottomPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.bottom, spacingAtMinSize));
+    readonly property int leftPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.left, spacingAtMinSize));
+    readonly property int rightPadding: Math.round(Math.min(thickPanelSvg.fixedMargins.right, spacingAtMinSize));
 
     readonly property int minPanelHeight: translucentItem.minimumDrawingHeight
     readonly property int minPanelWidth: translucentItem.minimumDrawingWidth
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Default non-floating bottom panel on master, left and right ends zoomed 5x: Kickoff and Peek at Desktop sit 8 px inside the panel's ends
Same panel with the fix: both end widgets are 4 px closer to the screen edges
Default floating panel on master, both ends zoomed 5x
Floating panel with the fix: the end widgets also move 4 px toward the panel's rounded ends
Non-floating vertical panel on master: Kickoff at the top end, the clock at the bottom end
Same vertical panel with the fix: both move 4 px toward the ends
Top panel with User Switcher first and Timer last on master: their text only kept its distance thanks to the panel's extra spacing
With the fix the panel's extra spacing is gone but the two widgets pad their own labels, so their text stays the same distance from the edges
